visual_review: Before was a tall box with a single wavy line and a band that read as a drum or bin; the scalloped valance and the hanging were not readable. Now a rounded canopy with a three-scallop valance, and a deep rounded basket hung below it on two straps.
omissions: the diagonal cross straps of the reference (they cross the basket and cannot keep 8 spacing)
